spec.title: Selected VPN server
spec.description: Server currently selected by the URL-test group

spec.title: Dead proxies
spec.description: Real VPN proxies with no valid latency (dead)

spec.title: Endpoint health
spec.description: Reachability of each polled endpoint (version / connections / proxies)

spec.title: Traffic last 5m
spec.description: Bytes transferred in the last 5 minutes. Uses increase(), so counter resets on sing-box restarts are handled.

spec.title: Proxy latency (last URL test)
spec.description: Last URL-test latency per server. Dead proxies have value 0.

spec.title: Proxy latency freshness
spec.description: Seconds since the last URL test that produced the reported delay. Growing lines mean stale (possibly dead) servers.

spec.title: Scrape errors (15m)
spec.description: Failed Clash API requests in the last 15 minutes (rate, survives exporter restarts)

spec.title: Last successful poll
spec.description: Seconds since the last poll in which the Clash API answered

spec.title: Live traffic by outbound
spec.description: In-flight bytes of currently active connections, grouped by the final outbound
